exposure: Neonates born to mothers without COVID-19
outcome: Respiratory diseases (transient tachypnea of the newborn, respiratory distress syndrome, meconium aspiration syndrome)
cohort: Neonates born to mothers with or without COVID-19 infection at the National Health Insurance Service Ilsan Hospital between February 2021 and March 2022, with gestational age ≥35+0 weeks and born within 2 weeks of maternal infection
finding: Newborns born to COVID-19-infected mothers are at increased risk of TTN and may require respiratory support.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean sections was significantly higher for neonates born to COVID-19-infected mothers compared to the control group (91% vs 40%).
